The final three-era editable natives, static GLBs and 69 matched views are in [retained04](loop03/delivery/retained04/); the [progress comparison](review-preparation/progress-review03.html) shows checkpoint09 and all three retained stages beside the pinned source.

Breast plating remains softer/more regular than the source, claws remain broad/short, and Maker/Mechanic finish distinction is weak. These are qualitative findings from actual source and matched images, not numerical reconstruction errors. Camera and hidden depth are estimated, and every reference has been used in development.

consequential_claims.claim: Documented position/UV and preservation predicates pass their stated scope; strict normalized normal parity fails and full shader/pixel equivalence is unproved.

evidence.quote: Fresh native checks pass tested preservation fields and 52/52 binding predicates per era. Final files contain 7690 mesh/empty payloads and 63 material graphs per era, with 164 packed FILE images for Advanced (stored as builder) and 163 for Maker/Mechanic. Joint material-indexed export position and UV checks pass within the pinned checker scope; all 145 embedded map images were decoded. Strict normalized normal parity remains FAIL at the unchanged 2e-5 L2 threshold: maximum 0.008557 L2 / 0.490292 degrees on a FEET02 toe retained from Loop02. The crown fails separately, while its 3824 stored GLB triangle-corner position/UV/normal records exactly match the previous crown. The cause of strict native/export normal error remains unknown. No complete shader or pixel equivalence is established.

consequential_claims.next_check: Carry fixed failure threshold/cause-unknown into release/backlog; no parity re-analysis delegated here.
